purpose: Freeze a finite zero-network concept-only frontier after the accepted local OHLCV/amount channels and Campaign157 cross-asset catalog were exhausted, preserving at most one genuinely new issuer facility/exogenous-hazard route for a separately frozen source-contract campaign before any source row, formula, direction or research value is opened.

bounded_repository_metadata_evidence.inspection_method: rg filename/content matches plus JSON metadata and prior terminal records only
bounded_repository_metadata_evidence.facility_location_match_interpretation: The sole match is a sensitive-facility-location exclusion inside Campaign206 waste-manifest lifecycle evidence, not an accepted issuer facility master or a hazard exposure factor.
bounded_repository_metadata_evidence.interpretation: Repository evidence contains terminal issuer-reported environmental metrics, realized incident disclosures and enforcement events, but no admitted point-in-time issuer facility master joined to an external physical-hazard observation history. This identifies a potentially new raw information channel; it does not establish source feasibility or predictive value.

concept_admission_gate.new_observed_state: The route must observe an external physical or public-health state at a time-versioned issuer facility rather than transform a terminal market, accounting, disclosure, incident or enforcement factor.
concept_admission_gate.point_in_time_identity: A later source contract must freeze legal entity, subsidiary, facility, coordinate, ownership/operation interval and public availability without current-facility survivorship backfill.
concept_admission_gate.complete_denominator: A later source contract must define all eligible issuers, including issuers with zero exposure, and prove complete 2019-2023 coverage before values.
concept_admission_gate.single_hypothesis: Only one hazard family, source clock, exposure operator, direction, support rule and missingness policy may be frozen before source rows; sibling hazards, thresholds and combinations remain closed.
concept_admission_gate.three_session_clock: Any eventual value must be knowable by the signal close and must enter only through the frozen t+1/t+3 walk-forward boundary.
concept_admission_gate.no_value_stage: Campaign269 may select a concept for later source-contract work but may not freeze a numeric formula or direction, create an adapter, request a provider, read rows, values, prices or returns.

finite_concept_catalog.name: issuer_facility_extreme_precipitation_or_flood_exposure
finite_concept_catalog.economic_state: An externally observed extreme-precipitation or inundation shock at a legally mapped operating facility, distinct from issuer self-disclosed incidents, environmental accounting and enforcement notices.
finite_concept_catalog.reason: The state is economically independent of terminal price, accounting, disclosure and enforcement factors, and the bounded repository inventory contains no accepted facility-hazard channel. Source feasibility is still unproved because historical facility identity, coordinates, operating intervals, hazard timestamps, spatial joins, zero-exposure denominator and corrections are not frozen.

finite_concept_catalog.name: issuer_facility_extreme_heat_or_cold_exposure
finite_concept_catalog.reason: Choosing precipitation, flood depth, heat, cold or degree-day thresholds before one facility master and one hazard contract is accepted would search event type, threshold, duration and direction inside the same exogenous facility-exposure family.

finite_concept_catalog.name: issuer_facility_typhoon_wind_rain_landfall_exposure
finite_concept_catalog.economic_state: Typhoon track, wind and rainfall exposure at issuer facilities.
finite_concept_catalog.reason: Track distance, wind radius, rainfall, landfall stage and exposure window are multiple operators over the same facility-hazard channel and may not be chosen before c269_01 source identity and zero-exposure semantics are accepted.

finite_concept_catalog.name: issuer_facility_earthquake_ground_motion_exposure
finite_concept_catalog.economic_state: Externally measured ground motion at issuer facilities.
finite_concept_catalog.reason: Ground motion is a distinct physical-hazard state, but a separate event catalog, station or grid version, facility mapping, aftershock identity and all-issuer denominator would be required. Campaign269 retains only one route to prevent source-family expansion.

finite_concept_catalog.name: issuer_facility_air_pollution_emergency_curtailment_exposure
finite_concept_catalog.economic_state: Official local air-pollution emergency and industrial curtailment state at issuer facilities.
finite_concept_catalog.reason: This is a regulatory operating constraint rather than the terminal environmental-penalty family, but it needs versioned local emergency notices, industry/facility applicability, start/end time, exemptions, revisions and a complete zero-exposure denominator before any formula can be considered.

finite_concept_catalog.name: issuer_facility_public_health_mobility_restriction_exposure
finite_concept_catalog.economic_state: Local public-health mobility or operating restrictions mapped to issuer facilities.
finite_concept_catalog.reason: The 2019-2023 interval would be dominated by a special policy regime, while restriction taxonomy, geographic applicability, facility operation and public timing are not stable. Freezing a direction or pooling jurisdictions now would manufacture an event-policy model rather than one source-admitted mechanism.

selection.required_next_stage: Campaign270 may separately freeze one exact zero-row source-admission contract for c269_01, including issuer/subsidiary/facility identity, point-in-time operating intervals, hazard provenance and revisions, spatial join, public clock, zero-exposure denominator, 2019-2023 coverage, missingness, formula, direction, support and all later gates before any row or value is read.
selection.fallback_if_contract_cannot_close: Terminalize c269_01 as a source-contract rejection without testing another hazard type, threshold, direction, spatial radius or event window in the same campaign.
